title: R1.3 · Play / no-play of long shots
instructions: Each item is one shot detected by the pipeline (only shots of 4 s or more), shown by three frames. Decide what the shot shows. Live play, wide: the match as it happens, seen from a camera that frames a large part of the pitch (main camera or wide alternative angles). Live play, close/medium: the match as it happens but tightly framed on a few players. Replay: anything re-broadcast (usually framed by a logo transition and without the live scoreboard), including VAR split screens. Other: close-ups of a single person, crowd, bench, coaches, pre-match and stoppages (injuries, substitutions) and graphics. Mixed: the three frames clearly come from different shots (a cut was missed). The suggestion comes from a visual pre-labelling, not from the pipeline.

options.label: Live play, wide/long view of the pitch
Live play, close or medium framing
Other (close-up of a person, crowd, bench, pre-match, stoppage, graphics)
Mixed (the frames belong to different shots)
